item.title: DRAGON QUEST X Will Have An AI Companion Powered By Google's Gemini
item.description: Square Enix reveals plans to add "Oshaberi Slimey," an AI companion using Google's Gemini, to Dragon Quest X Online. Closed beta applications open until March 30th as part of the "Living Games" initiative.

item.title: A CRIMSON DESERT RUMOR Is Spreading That Some Devs Think The Game Is A Disaster Over It's Story
item.description: Leaked claims from supposed Pearl Abyss developers suggest Crimson Desert's messy story and lack of identity stem from last-minute changes and copying features from other games without understanding them.

item.title: GGG Announces PATH OF EXILE 2 Speedrun Race Event Starting March 29th
item.description: Grinding Gear Games reveals The Last of the Druids speedrun race series for Path of Exile 2, running March 29th to April 12th. Players compete in Solo Self-Found Fate of the Vaal for great rewards.

item.title: Some FORTNITE Players Are Asking Epic Games For The Option To Disable Seeing Other Player Skins
item.description: Fortnite fans are making a push for a feature to disable unwanted skins, especially the recently teased brainrot cosmetics, citing visual clutter and personal preference.

item.title: New Study Claims RPG Players Are Most Susceptible To Post-Game Depression
item.description: New research from SWPS University suggests RPG players experience stronger post-game depression due to deep investment in character development and narrative choices. Read all about it here.

item.title: Riots Global Head Of LOL Esports Addresses First Stand Learnings, CBLOL Worlds Slot Addition, And More
item.description: Riot Games Global Head of LoL Esports discusses First Stand takeaways, the decision to grant CBLOL a 2nd Worlds slot, visa challenges for the 2026 event in the USA, and ongoing format experiments.

item.title: ARC RAIDERS Flashpoint Update Teases Shredder Arc Is Coming To Blue Gate, But Fans Aren’t Impressed
item.description: Embark Studios confirms the deadly Shredder enemy is coming to Blue Gate in ARC Raiders' latest update. However many players feel it lacks the fresh content they were hoping for.

item.title: Why Did WORLD OF WARCRAFT's Subscriber Numbers Plummet After Cataclysm? Here Is Why.
item.description: World of Warcraft hit its all-time peak of over 12 million subscribers just before Cataclysm launched in late 2010. Since then, the game has seen a steady decline in player counts due to many factors.

item.title: STARFINDER: AFTERLIGHT Is A New Sci-Fi RPG That Looks Promising For Gamers
item.description: Starfinder: Afterlight blends Baldur's Gate 3-style party-based RPG storytelling with a sci-fi adventure. The game is also currently running a public playtest on Steam until April 5th, 2026.

item.title: Epic Games Has Laid Off Over 1,000 Employees As FORTNITE Downturn Forces Major Cuts In Company
item.description: Epic Games is cutting more than 1,000 jobs after a Fortnite engagement slump that began in 2025 left the company spending more than it earns. Company faces industry pressure and more specific challenges.

item.title: DANTE vs VERGIL: New DEVIL MAY CRY Season 2 Trailer Packs Fury And Emotion
item.description: As Netflix drops an explosive Devil May Cry season 2 trailer, showrunner Adi Shankar teases a "Dark Knight" escalation in scale and scope.

item.title: FORTNITE Is Officially Shutting Down Rocket Racing, Ballistic, And Festival Battle Stage This Year
item.description: Epic Games has confirmed it will permanently remove three Fortnite game modes: Rocket Racing, Ballistic, and Festival Battle Stage in 2026 as part of cost-cutting measures following major layoffs.

item.title: PLAYSTATION Reportedly Shuts Down Its Newest First-Party Studio DARK OUTLAW GAMES
item.description: PlayStation is reportedly closing Dark Outlaw Games, the first-party studio founded last year by Call of Duty Zombies veteran Jason Blundell. The move is part of layoffs affecting around 50 jobs.

item.title: DESTINY 2 Guardian Games 2026 Returns With MAGIC: THE GATHERING Crossover And Fresh Rewards
item.description: Destiny 2 Guardian Games 2026 runs March 24 to April 14 with new weapons, remixed Rushdown mode, and a Magic: The Gathering crossover featuring Chandra, Jace, and Liliana armor sets plus Exotic cosmetics.

item.title: Rockstar Games QA Tester Jobs In Bangalore Offer Select Fans A Chance To Play GTA 6 Months Before Release
item.description: Rockstar Games is hiring Associate QA Testers in Bangalore, sparking speculation that select candidates could play Grand Theft Auto 6 a few months before its November 19th, 2026 release.
